描述_EN: (2014, november 4). 1van abel, b. beginning as a campaign in 2010 by designer bas van abel, fairphone was founded initially as a non-profit advocacy group to raise awareness of the relationship between conflict minerals and electronic goods. on 4 november 2014, van abel blogged about his ambitions for the next fairphone model, which would be fully designed in-house1. retrieved september 7, 2015. bethnal green ventures provided £15,000 investment and access to successful engineers and entrepreneurs in the technology sector. the route to fairphone becoming a real product started in 2012, when the company’s application for support was accepted by bethnal green ventures, an accelerator for tech startups with a social and environmental conscience. the fairphone is a smartphone with 110 mm (4.3 inch) screen, measured across the diagonal, with replaceable battery, two sim card slots and front and rear facing cameras. the fairphone is also part of our growing collection of objects representing new, ethical approaches to the manufacture and distribution of electronics, alongside the one laptop per child, aakash tablet and mwanga bora lantern, rare earthenware vases from unknown fields division and the toaster project from thomas thwaites. the smartphone itself is a mid-range device, with an open-source android operating system with user interface by kwamecorp. the drc is politically unstable with ongoing civil war and endemic corruption which has led to many mines being controlled by armed groups. next chapter in fairphone's strategy: outlook for 2015 | fairphone. despite never having produced a phone before, through extensive media campaigning fairphone reached the required 5000 on 5 june 2013. they then began to approach several manufacturers in china before being accepted by guohong (a subsidiary of a’hong), who agreed to an order of 25,000 taking the funds raised for 5000 as down payment for the larger consignment. shipping of the first 15,000 fairphone 2s has been set for november 2015, following the same crowdfunding goal as the first. it is based on a design licensed from chinese manufacturer a’hong, and is the first smartphone to be manufactured with a view to making the industry fairer and more sustainable. it would be one of the first smartphones on the market with modular components, so that if any parts failed they could be individually replaced by the consumer. it highlighted the lack of general understanding regarding the provenance of materials for consumer objects owned by almost every visitor to the museum. to make their ambition a reality, however, fairphone had to raise full manufacturing funding through an online campaign. one fairphone was displayed in a case in the silver gallery as part of the the civic objects distributed display of the 2015 exhibition all of this belongs to you. 5000 backers were asked to pay €325 for a phone before a manufacturer was even approached. this first production run sold out by november 2013, with a second batch of 35,000 phones produced and released on 21 may 2014. these were sold out by january 2015. smartphones use up to 60 different minerals in their manufacture, including tantalum, tungsten, tin and gold which are often extracted from ore mined in the democratic republic of congo. rich in natural resources, raw materials are this country’s largest export, 50% of which go to china where the majority of smartphone parts are made.
描述_ZN: （2014，11月4日）。 1范-阿贝尔，B. 2010年由设计师bas van abel发起的活动，fairphone最初是作为一个非营利性的倡导团体，以提高对冲突矿物和电子产品之间关系的认识。 2014年11月4日，van Abel在博客上写下了他对下一个fairphone模型的雄心，这将是完全内部设计的1。 2015年9月7日检索。 bethnal green ventures提供了15,000英镑的投资和接触技术领域成功的工程师和企业家的机会。 fairphone成为真正产品的路线始于2012年，当时该公司的支持申请被贝斯纳绿创投接受，这是一个为具有社会和环境意识的科技初创公司提供的加速器。 fairphone是一款智能手机，屏幕对角线长110毫米（4.3英寸），配有可更换的电池、两个SIM卡插槽和前后摄像头。 fairphone也是我们不断增长的收藏品的一部分，这些收藏品代表了制造和销售电子产品的新的道德方法，还有每个孩子一台笔记本电脑、Aakash平板电脑和Mwanga Bora灯笼、来自未知领域部门的稀有陶器花瓶和来自Thomas Thwaites的烤面包机项目。 该智能手机本身是一个中档设备，采用开源的安卓操作系统，用户界面由kwamecorp开发。 刚果民主共和国政治不稳定，内战不断，腐败成风，导致许多矿区被武装团体控制。 公平电话战略的下一章：2015年展望 | 公平电话。 尽管之前从未生产过手机，通过广泛的媒体宣传，fairphone在2013年6月5日达到了所需的5000人。 然后他们开始与中国的几家制造商接触，最后被国虹（A'hong的子公司）接受，国虹同意了25000部的订单，并将筹集到的5000部资金作为大宗货物的首付款。 首批15,000部fairphone 2s的发货时间已经确定为2015年11月，与第一部的众筹目标相同。 它基于中国制造商A'hong的授权设计，是第一款以使行业更公平和更可持续为目标而制造的智能手机。 它将是市场上第一批具有模块化组件的智能手机之一，因此，如果任何部件出现故障，消费者可以单独更换。 它强调了对博物馆几乎每个参观者所拥有的消费物品的材料来源缺乏普遍的了解。 为了使他们的雄心壮志成为现实，fairphone不得不通过在线活动筹集全部的制造资金。 一个fairphone被放在银色画廊的一个箱子里，作为2015年展览的公民物品分配展示的一部分，这些都是属于你的。 在与制造商接触之前，5000名支持者被要求为一部手机支付325欧元。 这第一批生产的手机在2013年11月卖完了，第二批生产的35000部手机在2014年5月21日发布。 这些产品在2015年1月前售罄。 智能手机在制造过程中使用了多达60种不同的矿物，包括钽、钨、锡和金，这些矿物通常是从刚果民主共和国开采的矿石中提取的。 自然资源丰富，原材料是这个国家最大的出口产品，其中50%出口到中国，大部分的智能手机部件都是在中国生产的。
